candidate.text: The carp's safely delivered, Ren. I'll get it into a stew tonight. Thanks for bringing it down to the west lane!
Ren! The carp arrived safe and sound—payment all settled. Been craving a fresh catch. Ready to talk pond spots and a good stew?
Thanks for the carp, Ren! I'll turn it into a nice pondside stew. Perfect timing for lunch.
Thanks for the carp, Ren! It's perfect for a fresh pond-style stew. Good doing business with you.
Good, the carp is delivered and the coin received. The pond's been calm today. I'll rest here a while, Sora.
The carp were moving slow near the shallows today. Your fish is ready, Sora. I'll drop it off on my way to rest.
Good to see the carp went through. The pond's calm today — I'll keep an eye on the water.
The carp's fresh and delivered. Good timing — the pond's been quiet today. Anything you'd like cooked with it?
Ren! The carp's here and it looks perfect. I'll get it into a stew tonight — thanks for the quick delivery!
Thanks for the carp, Ren! Fresh pond fish will be perfect for tonight's stew.
Thanks for the carp, Ren! Payment's settled. I'll turn this into something tasty at the pond. See you around!
Ren, the carp's arrived fresh—thanks! I'll get it simmering with some local herbs. Anything else biting out by the pond today?
Morning, Sora. The carp are biting well today. I brought one along for you, if the terms still suit.
Sora, good afternoon. Your carp is delivered and settled—25 coins, held as agreed. The pond's been calm today. Thank you for the trade.
The carp is delivered, Sora. Good to know the pond's small changes still reach your pot. Anything else you need from me?
The carp is yours, Sora. The pond's been kind today. I noticed small ripples near the reeds at dawn.
Ren! Carp delivered, payment settled — thanks. Now, any ideas for a pondside carp stew? I'm testing recipes today.
Ren, got the carp—thanks! Payment of 25 is settled. This will make a lovely pondside stew. Catch you next time!
Got the carp, Ren — thanks! Fresh fish is exactly what I needed. I'll get cooking soon. Want to swap ideas for a pond-side stew sometime?
Thanks for the carp, Ren! Delivery confirmed. What dish should we cook with it?
The carp is delivered, Sora. Pond's been calm all day. Let me know if you need more for the pot.
The carp's delivered and the coins are settled. Good doing business, Sora. The pond's been calm today.
Good, the carp is delivered and payment settled. The pond's been calm today. I'll head back to my spot if we're done.
Sora, good timing. The carp are biting well today — I brought the one we agreed on. It's fresh from the pond this morning.
Great, the carp is delivered and payment settled. Thanks, Ren! I'll get cooking with it soon.
Ren, the carp arrived perfectly fresh — thanks! I'm thinking a slow-simmered pond stew. Got any tips for the broth?
Perfect, one fresh carp received! I'll simmer it with local herbs for a hearty pondside stew. Thanks, Ren — see you at the next catch!
Thanks for the carp, Ren! This is perfect for a pondside stew tonight. Got any more fresh catches coming?
The carp is delivered, Sora. Good timing too — the pond's been quiet all midday. Anything you want to change about the next batch?
Sora, the carp is yours — payment received, and I appreciate it. The pond's been quiet today. Good cooking to you.
Sora, good to see you. The carp's already delivered, quiet as the pond this morning. Anything else you need from me?
Good, the carp is yours, Sora. The pond was calm this morning. What are you cooking with it?
Ren, the carp just arrived and it's beautiful! I'll get it cleaned and on the fire. Thanks for the quick delivery!
Carp delivered and payment squared, Ren! Fresh fish like this is perfect for a pondside stew. Thanks for meeting me — let's cook together soon.
Thanks for the carp, Ren! It's fresh and perfect for tonight's stew. See you by the pond again soon!
Ren, the carp's safely delivered — thank you! With fish like this I can finally try that pond-side stew I've been dreaming up.
Sora, the carp is delivered and settled. The pond's been quiet today. I noticed the reeds shifting near the east bank. Anything you'd like cooked with the fish?
Sora, the carp are biting well today. That one I brought is fresh — hope it serves your pot nicely.
The carp's delivered and the pond's calm today. Sora, is there anything else you need before we head back?
The carp is yours, Sora. Twenty-five coins settled it. I'll keep watching the pond — the water's been quiet today.
